description: Sets the address of a project’s building site: looks it up on OpenStreetMap for sun position and shadows, and loads neighbouring buildings, roads and terrain around it into the model (OpenStreetMap, EU-DEM; takes about a minute, then visible in vedutum_get_project). Replaces the previous address; vedutum_undo_last_change goes back. Costs no points.

address.description: Street address with postcode and town, e.g. "Lindenweg 7, 8010 Graz"

language.description: Language of the answer: "de" (German) or "en" (English). Default "de".

project_id.description: Project id, as vedutum_list_projects returns it

surroundings.description: Also load neighbouring buildings and terrain (default true)

name: vedutum_set_site_address
title: Set the site address and load the surroundings
